aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.titulo: Top Google Ranking for IV Therapy Clinic in Barcelona
aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.problema: To improve sales for this high-profit-margin treatment.
aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.solucion: Informative content about the different IV Therapy compounds was developed, and a market analysis of the United States was conducted to adapt it to the Spanish market.
aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.resultado: We achieved a 564% increase in organic traffic in 3 months and a 45% rise in sales directly attributed to organic search within one month.

seo-local-macan.titulo: Organic Positioning Improvement for Law Firm
seo-local-macan.problema: The law firm needed to improve its visibility on Google to attract new clients.
seo-local-macan.solucion: After a technical audit, tags were improved, competitor keywords were included, and the website's structure was optimized.
seo-local-macan.resultado: As a result of the work done, organic visibility increased by 466%, and SERP positioning improved, leading to a 249% increase in clicks.
